text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} is walking around the city for his part-time delivery job.
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}は、配達のバイトで市街地を歩き回っていた。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, {0}.
What are you doing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
{0}君。
何してるの？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it seems like you're working hard for your part-time job.
Balancing education and work is very admirable!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか、
バイトを頑張ってるんだね。
学業とバイトの両立だなんて
偉い！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
As for me, I'm visiting my students' homes.
It's a lot of work going from place to place.
text_block_list.orig_text:
先生は、
家庭訪問をしてるところだよ。
あちこち回らなくちゃいけなくて大変なの。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
In order to lose to you as a teacher, I need to work hard with my home visits!
Well then, take care!
text_block_list.orig_text:
生徒の君に負けないように、
先生もしっかり家庭訪問頑張らなくちゃ！
それじゃ、
気を付けてね～

text_block_list.text: I'll be right there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい、
今行きまーす。

text_block_list.name: Female Student
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Io's boyfriend from the cooking session the other day!
Are you doing part-time delivery work? You must be tired!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
この前の調理実習にいたイオちゃんの彼氏だ！
配達のバイトをしてるの？　
ごくろうさま～！

text_block_list.name: Female Student
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right!
Actually, just now, Io came to visit my home...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ！
あのね、
さっき
イオちゃんも家庭訪問でうちに来たんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Female Student
text_block_list.text:
On the way to the next student's house,
there's a place rumored to have monsters appearing recently!
text_block_list.orig_text:
次に向かう子の家の途中に、
最近よく魔物が出没するって噂になってる場所があるの！

text_block_list.name: Female Student
text_block_list.text:
I haven't heard about any attacks,
and Io said she'll be fine, but I'm really worried!
text_block_list.orig_text:
人を襲ったって話は聞かないし、
イオちゃんも大丈夫って言ってたんだけど、
私心配で仕方ないよ！

text_block_list.name: Female Student
text_block_list.text:
You're Io's boyfriend, right?
I don't want her to get hurt!
Please go and save her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなた、
イオちゃんの彼氏でしょ？
もしもイオちゃんに何かあったら大変だよ！
助けに行ってあげて！

text_block_list.text: Ahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ああ～ん！

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hold on! Wait a minute!
Stop!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと、
待って～！
やめて～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Huh, {0}?!
What are you doing here... Ahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、{0}君！？
どうしてここに……
きゃあ！？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*
Why did you suddenly run?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあっ、
はあっ。
急に走ってどうしたの？

text_block_list.text: Myuuun... Myuuun...
text_block_list.orig_text: みゅーん……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
S-stop for a moment!
Did you hear it too? That crying sound just now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
ちょっと止まって！
君も聞こえた？　
今の鳴き声。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Right, it's the cry of a small monster.
I need to check it out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
そう、
小さな魔物の声だよ。
様子を見に行かなくちゃ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Are you coming with me because it's dangerous?
Thank you.
But I think I'll be okay...
text_block_list.orig_text:
危ないから、
付いてきてくれるの？
ありがとう。
でも、
多分大丈夫だから……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I knew it—you're stuck in a trap!
Hold on,  I'll get you out right away.
Ughh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり罠にかかってたのね！
待っててね、
すぐに外してあげるから。
んん～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
...*pant* *pant*
I can't—I'm not strong enough...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はあ、
はあ。
ダメね、
私の力じゃ……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Well, it seems like it's in pain! I can't just leave it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって、
痛そうにしてるのに
ほっとけないよ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I must do something...! I'll try again...!
Ughh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんとかしなくちゃ……
もう一回……！
んん～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
My strength...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？
急に力が……！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Yay! I got it out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やった！　
外れたわ！

text_block_list.name: Little Monster
text_block_list.text: Myuuun! Myuuun!
text_block_list.orig_text: みゅ～ん！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Ahh! It...it leaped right into my chest!
That tickles!
Hahaha, I'm glad you're doing okay.
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃっ！　
この子、
胸に飛び込んできたわ！
くすぐったいじゃない。
あはは、
元気そうでよかった。

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAGGHHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: Myuuun! Myuuun!
text_block_list.orig_text: みゅ～ん！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Ahhhh! That tickles!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ～ん！　
くすぐったいわ～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, you're licking too much!
N-no, not there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
あちこち舐め過ぎよ～
そ、
そこはダメ～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Haha, everyone, please wait!
I need to explain this to {0}!
Wait!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはっ、
みんな待って～
今
{0}君に説明するから～
ちょっと～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why are you licking too?!
Hahaha, are you trying to tease me?
Hey, stop!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
どうして君も舐めるの！？
あははっ、
先生をからかうつもり～？
こら、
ダメ～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: {0}, listen...
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}君、あのね……

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAGGHHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why are you making such scary noises suddenly?
This didn't happen when I was alone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
どうして急に怖い声を出すの？
私一人のときは
こんなことなかったのに。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Is it because you're cautious with strangers?
He's a good person, so don't worry.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして、
知らない人がいるから警戒してるの？
彼はいい人だから、
安心して。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh no...
They're so excited, they're not even listening.
I guess I have no choice...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダメね……
興奮しちゃって、
聞き分けがなくなってるみたい。
仕方ないけど、
こうなったら……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hey, here's your teacher's whip of love!
Everyone, calm down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～い、
先生の愛の鞭よ！
みんな落ち着いて～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Not even listening to your teacher? Since when are you all so naughty?
It's good to be energetic, but you can't cause trouble for others, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
先生の言うことが聞けないなんて、
みんないつ不良になっちゃったの？
元気なのはいいけど、
他の人に迷惑かけちゃダメでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
It's okay—he's a good person.
He's kind, and reliable... He's always helping me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫よ、
彼はとってもいい人なんだから。
優しくて
頼りがいがあって……
私を
いつも助けてくれるんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: It's even thanks to him that I was able to save you all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたたちを助けられたのも、
彼のおかげなの！

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: Myuu, myuuuuuun... ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
みゅ、
みゅ～～～ん……♪

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand what I'm saying now...?
Let me talk to him. Okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
先生の気持ち、
ちゃんと届いたかな……？
彼とお話しさせてね。
分かった？

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: Myuun. ♪ Myuun. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: みゅ～ん♪

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh good, everyone's behaving again.
Now can you give him a friendly handshake?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかった、
みんないい子に戻ってくれたわ～
彼と友達の握手、
できるかな？

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: Myumyuuuuun. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: みゅみゅ～～～ん♪

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Seeing that you're making more friends makes me really happy too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君に友達が増えて、
私もうれしいわ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're surprised, right?
But I guess it's only normal since you're being surrounded by so many monsters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
びっくりしてるよね？
こんなにも魔物たちに囲まれているから
仕方ないか。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember when those people in town
were trying to exterminate a monster I saved?
text_block_list.orig_text:
前にね、
私が助けてあげた魔物が
町の人たちから退治されそうになったときのこと覚えてる？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
At that time, you were on my side, and you helped me, right?
I was really moved by your reliable figure.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの時、
君が私たちの味方をして、
助けてくれたでしょ？
君の頼れる姿に
すごく感動したんだ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
And also, you've grown so much since we met.
Even your test scores are improving, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに君は、
初めて会ったときからぐんぐん成長してて、
テストの成績も少しずつよくなってるじゃない？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Though I'm the teacher, you're always the one helping me.
It makes me want to help others too,
so I decided to help these injured monsters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
先生なのに
いつも助けられてばかりだから、
私も
君みたいに何かしなきゃと思って、
こうして怪我している魔物たちのお世話をしてあげたりしてるの。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
It would be so awful if these traps made them hate people and
start attacking them! Lots of kids walk through here on the way to
school, and if anything were to happen to one of my students...
text_block_list.orig_text:
罠にかかったことで
人間のことを嫌いになって襲ってきたら大変でしょ？
この辺りが通学路になってる生徒も多いから、
もしルーセント学院の子たちに何かあったらって思うと……

text_block_list.name: Little Monster
text_block_list.text: Myuuun!
text_block_list.orig_text: みゅ～ん！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
See? If you face them one by one, they're all good kids, right?
This one is Garu, and these are Goh and Kiipon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら見て。
一匹一匹向き合えば、
みんないい子でしょ？
この子がガルちゃん、
こっちがゴウさんに
キーぽん！

text_block_list.name: Garu and others (monsters)
text_block_list.text:
Gaugau!
Gufugufu!
Ukiki!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ガウガウ！
グフグフ！
ウキキー！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
When you came by earlier, I was playing with these little ones.
Although they were injured at first, they're all so full of energy now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっき君がやって来たときは、
この子たちと遊んでいたの。
みんな最初は傷ついていたけど、
もうすっかり元気になったみたい。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Back then, you grabbed me and ran off,
so I think maybe they mistook you for a bad guy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの時、
突然私を連れて走ったから、
それでみんなが
君の事を悪い人だって勘違いしちゃったのかもね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
But I guess it's also thanks to you
that I was able to save them so quickly.
Once again, I'm being helped by you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
今日は君がそばにいたからなのか、
新しい子をすぐに助けることができたわ。
もしかして、
また君に助けられちゃったのかな。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Wait, aren't you in the middle of your part-time job?
Why are you here?
choice_data_list: Earlier when I was making my delivery...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば、
バイト中のはずだったよね？
どうしてこんなところに？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh...
So you were at my student's place, huh.
And then you tried to chase after me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんうん……
私が訪問した生徒のお家に行ったのね。
それで
私のあとを追いかけてきたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
What?!
She thought you were my boyfriend too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！
あの子にも彼氏だと思われてたの？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Why didn't you deny it?
Is it because you're thinking the same thing...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
君もどうしていつも否定しないのよ～！
それって、
もしかして君もそう思ってるってこと……？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe they think you're my boyfriend when you're my student.
Well, I guess for a first boyfriend, I do want someone reliable and kind like you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
君は私の生徒なんだし、
そんな彼氏だなんて。
確かに、
初めての彼氏は
頼りがいがあって、優しい
君みたいな人が……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I see, if you...
become my first... then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか、
君が……
君が初めての……
なら……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
H-hey.
Next weekend, are you free?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ね、
ねえ。
今度の週末は
予定空いてるかな？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Really?
Well... do you wanna go out?
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当？
それじゃあ……
一緒にお出かけしない？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Not just going shopping like before,
but a real date... like couples go on...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これまでのデートみたいなお買いものじゃなくて、
その、
カップルがする……
デートを……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Really? Yay!
Then I guess we're done with the practice questions.
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当？　
よかった～
それじゃ
もう練習問題は終わりだね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I never thought
asking someone out would be so nerve-racking. It's so embarrassing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
デートのお誘いって、
こんなにも緊張して、
恥ずかしいなんて
知らなかったわ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I need to get back to visiting my students.
You too—take care at your part-time job!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
私はそろそろ家庭訪問に戻らなきゃ。
君もバイト
気を付けてね！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Ahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃあっ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhh!
I'm stuck in Kuru's tail! Help me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ～ん！
クルちゃんの尻尾に絡まっちゃった～
助けて～！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
After a while, Io's new monster friends
became famous guardians for the students from Lucent Academy,
and even the people of the neighborhood began to accept them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しばらくして、イオが仲良くなった魔物たちは、
ルーセント学院の生徒たちの登下校を見守る名物として
近隣住民から受け入れられるようになるのだった。
